questions.question: You cannot imagine how ______ I felt when I was faced with so many difficulties.
questions.explanation: overwhelmed 被压得喘不过气、难以招架；overflowed 溢出；overthrown 被推翻；overturned 被掀翻或被撤销。

questions.question: His ______ was taken as part of lawsuit between American aviation and Yahoo.
questions.explanation: deposition 法律中的宣誓证词，take a deposition 录取证词；desperation 绝望；depreciation 贬值、折旧；depression 抑郁或萧条。

questions.question: In the present economic ______ we cannot make even greater progress than previously.
questions.explanation: economic climate 指经济环境、经济形势；其余选项不构成这里的惯用表达。

questions.question: The computer revolution may well change society as ______ as did the Industrial Revolution.
questions.explanation: fundamentally 表示从根本上，比较的是两场变革改变社会的程度。

questions.question: This course ______ several different aspects of economics.
questions.explanation: embrace 除“拥抱”外还指“涵盖”；elaborate 详述；exaggerate 夸大；embark on 开始从事。课程涵盖若干领域，选 embraces。

questions.question: Many words in the English language are French in ______.
questions.explanation: in origin 表示在起源上；词语的法语来源用 French in origin。

questions.question: She refused to ______ to my going abroad.
questions.explanation: consent to 表示同意，to 为介词，后接动名词 my going。

questions.question: Most people who marry young start out living <u>hand to mouth</u>. The underlined part means ______.
questions.explanation: live hand to mouth 指收入仅够维持生活、难有积蓄，对应 poorly。

questions.question: The housing price in big cities is ______, but still many young people would rather buy a house than rent a room.
questions.explanation: soar 表示价格迅速上涨；sneak 偷偷行动，soak 浸泡，spin 旋转。

questions.question: He had a(n) ______ when he entered the hotel that the gatekeeper was a detective.
questions.explanation: illusion 对现实的错误认识；fantasy 幻想情境；imagination 想象力；vision 视力、景象或愿景。把门卫误以为侦探，选 illusion。

questions.question: The campaign to stop people from smoking is in <u>full swing</u>. The underlined part means ______.
questions.explanation: in full swing 表示活动正热烈进行；这里 swing 的释义对应 progress。

questions.question: The ______ law did not make a clear distinction between the new and old land boundary.
questions.explanation: ambiguous 表示含糊、有歧义，与未作清楚区分相呼应。

questions.question: These contradictions made his evidence ______.
questions.explanation: worthless 无价值；invaluable 极有价值，绝不是“没有价值”；priceless 无价的；unworthy 不配的，常接 of。矛盾使证据失去价值。

questions.question: So many people have bought this brand of bikes that the store is now out of ______.
questions.explanation: out of stock 表示缺货；很多人购买导致库存售罄。

questions.question: I was feeling <u>dragged out</u> so I went home. The underlined part means ______.
questions.explanation: dragged out 在此指筋疲力尽，对应 exhausted；不是“被拖出去”。tedious 令人厌烦；cold 寒冷；sick 生病。

questions.question: I almost sing every song out of ______ each time I try to hit the high notes.
questions.explanation: out of tune 表示走调、不合音调，与唱高音时失准相呼应。

questions.question: Fred and Betty finally decided to <u>tie the knot</u>. The underlined part means ______.
questions.explanation: tie the knot 是结婚的习语，对应 get married。

questions.question: Joyce was a little ______ about whether he would marry her or not.
questions.explanation: be vague about 含糊其辞、说得不明确；ambiguous 有歧义、可作多种解释；obscure 晦涩难懂或不知名；dim 昏暗、模糊的印象。重点搭配 vague about。

questions.question: It was ______ that the school discriminated against Asian students.
questions.explanation: It was alleged that… 表示据称、有人指称；allege 可引出未经证实的指控。

questions.question: The scientists have absolute freedom as to what research they think is best to ______.
questions.explanation: pursue research 从事研究，可直接接 research；devote…to… 献身于；engage in research 参与研究；seek 寻求，不通常用 seek research 表“开展研究”。

questions.question: It's hard to change many Americans' ______ view that Germans lack a sense of humor and are always buried in work.
questions.explanation: stereotypical 指以固定模式概括群体的刻板看法，吻合对德国人的概括。

questions.question: Shanghai's thousands of telephone ______ may be revamped to provide mobile-phone chargers and Wi-Fi.
questions.explanation: telephone booth 指电话亭；可改造提供充电和网络服务。

questions.question: We consider it quite necessary to ______ the case before doing anything else.
questions.explanation: look into a case 表示调查案件；look after 照料，look over 检查，look through 浏览。

questions.question: These magnificent ______ buildings demonstrate the great intelligence of the laboring people.
questions.explanation: ancient buildings 指古代建筑；primitive 原始的，remote 遥远的，antique 通常用于古董物件。

questions.question: These goods are ______ for export, though a few of them may be sold on the home market.
questions.explanation: essentially 在此表示主要、基本上；少量内销使 completely 的全部出口不合语境。

questions.question: Sometimes it's good to stop for a while to think about the past and ______ the future.
questions.explanation: contemplate 表示认真思考、考虑；与 think about the past 并列。

questions.question: School fees, illness, house repairs and other ______ have reduced his bank balance to almost nothing.
questions.explanation: expenses 指各项开支，与学费、疾病费用和修房费用构成同类列举。

questions.question: There’s no denying that as we age ______, our body ages right along with us.
questions.explanation: chronologically 按时间推移，在此是“日历年龄增长”；significantly 显著地；deceptively 具有迷惑性地；deliberately 故意地。不要把 chronologically 只限于叙事排序。

questions.question: We made an effort not to <u>leave</u> my friend <u>out in the cold</u> when we were planning the birthday party. The underlined part means ______.
questions.explanation: leave sb out in the cold 指冷落、将某人排除在外，最接近 ignore。

questions.question: The company has to make its accounts and operations as ______ as possible.
questions.explanation: transparent 账目、运作公开透明；distinct 清晰可辨、不同的；evident 明显的；explicit 说法、规定明确的。公司治理中的“透明”优先选 transparent。

questions.question: The police are trying to ______ who killed the old woman.
questions.explanation: ascertain 查明、确定；ascribe…to… 把……归因于；avert 避免、转移视线；assert 断言、主张。调查凶手身份选 ascertain。

questions.question: The town's only claim to ______ is that Queen Elizabeth I once visited it.
questions.explanation: claim to fame 指使人或事物出名的特点、事迹；这里是女王曾来访。

questions.question: She once made a(n) ______ appearance on television before she decided to step away from the entertainment industry.
questions.explanation: brief appearance 表示短暂露面；instant 即刻的，prompt 及时的，transient 多描述短暂存在的状态。

questions.question: I am terribly ______ after a whole day’s working.
questions.explanation: worn out 筋疲力尽；worn down 被长期消磨、拖垮；worn away 磨蚀；worn off 效果消退。干了一整天后累坏了，优先 worn out。

questions.question: The caterers must know ______ how many people come for dinner.
questions.explanation: approximately 表示大约，修饰就餐人数的估计；其余副词不符合人数估算。

questions.question: This sweater is made of ______ wool and is much warmer than other kinds of sweater.
questions.explanation: pure wool 指纯羊毛材料；utter、thorough 不用于这里的材料纯度。

questions.question: He planned to steal the money, but his ______ were discovered.
questions.explanation: schemes 可指秘密策划的阴谋、诡计，吻合偷钱计划被发现。

questions.question: That you cannot feel the movement of earth does not mean that the earth is really ______.
questions.explanation: stationary 静止的；steady 稳定、平稳的；sturdy 结实健壮的；stubborn 固执的。别混淆 stationary 与 stationery“文具”。

questions.question: There were twenty people <u>at the very outside</u>. The underlined part means ______.
questions.explanation: at the (very) outside = 最多、顶多，等于 at most；不是“在外面”。at least 至少；at last 最后；untold 数不清的。

questions.question: His car was ______ to avoid bumping against the roadblock.
questions.explanation: swerve 指使车辆突然改变方向、急转弯，吻合避开路障。

questions.question: He will be doing his best to ______ himself on his opponent for last year's defeat.
questions.explanation: revenge oneself on sb for sth 表示因某事向某人报复。

questions.question: The French, long proud of their reputation for high-class cuisine, strongly ______ on the saying: they are the least attracted to quick meals.
questions.explanation: frown on 表示不赞同、反对；reckon on 与 figure on 表指望，speculate on 表推测或投机。此处表达对该说法的不赞同。

questions.question: The prisoner was questioned for three hours but he remained ______ throughout his trial.
questions.explanation: dumb 在此是缄口不言、沉默；inarticulate 表达不清、说不出连贯话，不必然完全不说话；blind 看不见；deaf 听不见。

questions.question: The super star turned down interview requests, saying he preferred to keep a low ______.
questions.explanation: keep a low profile 表示保持低调、不引人注意。

questions.question: Such a decision would ______ a huge political risk in the midst of the presidential campaign.
questions.explanation: entail 必然涉及、带来，可直接接 risk；result 要接 in 才能表示“导致”；assure 向人保证；accomplish 完成目标或任务。

questions.question: Scientists first ______ the idea of atomic bomb in the 1930’s.
questions.explanation: conceive an idea 构想、提出想法；perceive 感知、察觉；deceive 欺骗；relieve 缓解。先在头脑中构思，用 conceive。

questions.question: We finished all of the food <u>at a sitting</u>. The underlined part means ______.
questions.explanation: at a sitting 表示一口气、一次坐下来期间，最接近 at one time；in time 及时，on time 准时。

questions.question: The mayor ______ his political view on the radio.
questions.explanation: set forth 表示阐述、陈述观点；set up 建立，set about 着手，set in 开始并持续。

questions.question: The Navy is warning ships to stay away from the coast of Somalia after a series of ______ attacks there.
questions.explanation: pirate 指海盗，海军警告船只避开海岸的情境对应海盗袭击。

questions.question: The government ______ between the workers and the employers.
questions.explanation: mediate between A and B 在双方之间调解；reconcile A with B 或 reconcile A and B 使和解；interfere in/with 干涉；involve 牵涉。直接看 between 即可。

questions.question: If you are like most people, then chances are you often ______ others while they are still talking.
questions.explanation: interrupt others 指打断别人说话；interfere、intervene 通常还需介词，disturb 指打扰。

questions.question: Benjamin was <u>sweating bullets</u> by the time the police had finished questioning him. The underlined part means ______.
questions.explanation: sweat bullets 是极度紧张、害怕得冒汗的习语，对应 very frightened。

questions.question: Frankly, I hope that we can develop a ______ quality product.
questions.explanation: durable 耐磨耐用，适合产品；lasting 持续很久，常配 impression/effect；permanent 长期固定、非临时；perpetual 不断持续或反复，常配 motion/complaints。

questions.question: One third of the Chinese in the United States live in California, ______ in the San Francisco area.
questions.explanation: predominantly 表示主要地、占绝大多数地，说明在加州的地域集中情况。

questions.question: You can ______ your muscles more powerfully by linking up your breathing to the exercise.
questions.explanation: contract muscles 收缩肌肉；condense 凝结或浓缩内容；compress 用外力压缩；shrink 体积缩小、缩水。生理上的肌肉收缩，选 contract。

questions.question: The London Marathon is a difficult race. ______, thousands of runners participate every year.
questions.explanation: nevertheless 表示尽管如此，连接比赛艰难与仍有大量参与者的转折关系。

questions.question: The deal ______ before it was signed and sealed, even after the Letter of Intent was drawn up.
questions.explanation: fall through 计划、交易落空；fall for 上当或迷恋；fall in with 偶遇、同意；fall out 争吵失和或掉落。交易未签成，选 fell through。

questions.question: No matter how hard you try, you can find no <u>parallel</u> existing between them. The underlined part means ______.
questions.explanation: parallel 作名词可指相似或可比之处，对应 analogy；不是平行线的字面义。

questions.question: Alan argued that the best teachers should be rewarded with salaries <u>on a par with</u> doctors and lawyers. The underlined part means ______.
questions.explanation: on a par with 指与……处于同等水平，最接近 equivalent to，不要求完全一模一样。

questions.question: We ______ to refund your money if you are not satisfied with your purchase.
questions.explanation: guarantee to do 承诺做；assure sb of/that 使人放心；ensure that 确保结果；insure 给……保险。能直接接 to refund 表承诺的是 guarantee。

questions.question: The official ______ the interview on the sensitive issue.
questions.explanation: turn down an interview 表示拒绝采访；turn back 返回，turn around 转向，turn out 结果是。

questions.question: Fiber-optic cables can carry hundreds of telephone conversations ______.
questions.explanation: simultaneously 指同时地，说明光纤能同时传输大量通话。

questions.question: He was reading excitedly the book published by his company in ______ with a famous press.
questions.explanation: in collaboration with 表示与……合作，吻合联合出版。

questions.question: American History is one of the elective studies in the university ______.
questions.explanation: curriculum 学校或专业的整体课程体系；syllabus 某课程的教学大纲；course 一门课程；schedule 时间表。大学全部课程中的选修科目，选 curriculum。

questions.question: Our neighbours are so <u>reserved</u> and unfriendly that they never speak to us. The underlined part means ______.
questions.explanation: reserved 在此指少言、疏离，最接近 aloof；relieved 如释重负，resistant 抵抗的。

questions.question: The vase he bought at the street market yesterday was a ______ forgery.
questions.explanation: crude forgery 指粗劣的仿品；crude 在此强调制作粗糙、伪造拙劣。

questions.question: Being ______ about food can not only make children suffer from malnutrition but also influence their growth of intelligence.
questions.explanation: be particular about food 表示挑食；partial 常与 to 搭配，peculiar 奇特，pathetic 可怜。

questions.question: Mary was <u>in a lather</u> when she heard that she would be transferred to another department. The underlined part means ______.
questions.explanation: in a lather 焦躁不安、激动，选 agitated；scared 害怕；hesitant 犹豫；shocked 震惊。字面是“泡沫”，此处是习语。

questions.question: Many remarkable people deal with depression and anxiety all the time because they see the world differently than ______ people do.
questions.explanation: average people 指普通人，与 remarkable people 对比；moderate 温和，general 一般性的，universal 普遍的。

questions.question: Under no ______ should we seek temporary economic development at the expense of the environment and resources.
questions.explanation: under no circumstances 表示绝不、无论如何都不；否定短语前置，引起 should we 部分倒装。

questions.question: They <u>are at odds</u> over the funding for the project. The underlined part means ______.
questions.explanation: be at odds 表示意见不一致，对应 disagree；不必已经争吵或公开辩论。

questions.question: The police have received ______ information that the wanted murderer is still on the run.
questions.explanation: credible information 指可信的信息；chaotic 混乱，chronic 长期的，cautious 谨慎的。

questions.question: If you are not sure of the address, call and ask ______ to the interview.
questions.explanation: prior to = before，作为介词短语表示“在面试之前”。former 前任、前者；preceding 紧前的；previous 先前的，都不直接构成这里的 ______ to。

questions.question: This film documents the President Teddy Roosevelt’s ______ to what is now Kenya in 1909.
questions.explanation: expedition 有组织、为探险或考察等目的进行的远行；cruise 海上游览；excursion 短途出游；voyage 航海或太空等长途旅行。明确探险情境选 expedition。

questions.question: The newly built school offers courses in every subject ______.
questions.explanation: every subject imaginable 一切能想得到的学科，imaginable 常后置；imaginary 虚构的；imaginative 富有想象力的；imagined 被设想出来的。

questions.question: Forty people were killed in a ______ on the railway yesterday.
questions.explanation: collision 指碰撞，吻合铁路撞车事故；collapse 坍塌，corrosion 腐蚀，confrontation 对抗。

questions.question: I have an <u>itch</u> to go fishing this summer. The underlined word means ______.
questions.explanation: an itch to do 表示想做某事的强烈愿望；itch 在此不是皮肤发痒。

questions.question: On further examination it was found that the signature was not ______.
questions.explanation: genuine signature 指真实、非伪造的签名；genetic 遗传的，genial 和蔼的，generic 通用的。

questions.question: Having recurrent dreams is not necessarily ______ of any psychological problem.
questions.explanation: be indicative of 是……的迹象、表明……；positive of/about 确信；revealing 有启示的、揭露性的；evident 明显的。这里看固定搭配 indicative of。

questions.question: A similar approach can be ______ to innovation.
questions.explanation: apply an approach to sth 表示把方法应用于某事；这里为被动 applied to。

questions.question: Can you imagine that the apparently ______ man does such nasty things?
questions.explanation: respectable 体面、值得尊敬；respectful 对别人恭敬；respective 各自的；realistic 现实的。apparently 与 nasty 形成“看起来体面，却做坏事”的反差。

questions.question: The place did not appear to be popular, for it was completely deserted, and in any case ______ to traffic.
questions.explanation: inaccessible to traffic 表示交通无法到达；incompatible with 才表示不相容。

questions.question: The ______ heat has dried up the pond.
questions.explanation: intense 强烈的程度：intense heat/pain；intensive 高强度、密集投入的方式：intensive training/course；extensive 广泛的；concentrated 集中的、浓缩的。

questions.question: Never believe Tom, who was such a ______ character.
questions.explanation: suspicious 可表示令人怀疑、不可信的，与 Never believe 相呼应；gracious 亲切，conspicuous 显眼。

questions.question: In order to ______ the identity of a candidate, we may ask you to show your ID.
questions.explanation: verify 核实是否属实；examine 检查研究；ensure 确保某结果；testify 提供证言、作证，常用 testify to/that。凭证件核实身份，用 verify。

questions.question: Dreams are ______ in themselves, but, when combined with other data, they can tell us much about the dreamer.
questions.explanation: uninformative 表示不能提供多少信息，与结合其他资料后能说明很多情况形成对比。

questions.question: Our journey was slow because the train stopped ______ at different villages.
questions.explanation: continually 一次又一次，允许间断；continuously 连续不断；unceasingly 不停歇；gradually 逐渐。火车是走一段停一次，属于反复而非始终停止。

questions.question: The tuition fees are ______ to students coming from low-income families.
questions.explanation: affordable 表示负担得起，适合描述学费相对学生家庭收入的可承受性。

questions.question: Thousands of ______ at the stadium came to their feet to pay tribute to an outstanding performance.
questions.explanation: spectators 是体育场的观众，可直接作可数复数；audience 为集合名词，不能在此表示数千名个人观众。

questions.question: I’m supposed to go to the meeting, but I have an <u>out</u>—Sam invited me first to come to his wedding. The underlined word means ______.
questions.explanation: an out = 脱身的办法、退出的借口；这里有婚礼邀请可作为不参加会议的理由。out 不只是副词“出去”。

questions.question: He was accepted as a(n) ______ member of staff after three months' probation.
questions.explanation: permanent member of staff 表示正式、长期雇用的员工，与试用期结束相呼应。

questions.question: These low-budget animated films are the main source of ______ of this independent studio.
questions.explanation: income 指工作室的收入来源；pay、salary、wage 通常指个人工作报酬。

questions.question: The boy will be in <u>deep water</u> if he does not tell us where he spent the money. The underlined part means ______.
questions.explanation: in deep water 是陷入困境、遇上麻烦的习语，对应 trouble。

questions.question: I hope to ______ my umbrella which I left in the taxi.
questions.explanation: retrieve 找回、取回遗失物；restore 恢复原状态、修复；retain 保留；repel 排斥、击退。伞留在出租车上，希望“找回”，选 retrieve。

questions.question: A teacher who is skillful in delivering his lecture can undoubtedly ______ the mind of students.
questions.explanation: inspire 启发思想、激起灵感；encourage 鼓励、给予信心；motivate 提供行动动力；promote 促进或晋升。这里 the mind 与启发思维相连，选 inspire。

questions.question: This program can help freshmen make a successful ______ into college life.
questions.explanation: transition into/to 过渡到新阶段；transformation 形态或性质转变；transmission 传输；transaction 交易。新生适应大学是 transition。

questions.question: Will the widening ______ between the rich and poor reverse?
questions.explanation: chasm 裂隙、鸿沟，也指巨大差距；widening chasm 越来越大的鸿沟。cheat 欺骗者或欺骗；charm 魅力；chase 追逐。

questions.question: Time is a ______ performer. It flies, marches on, heals all wounds, runs out and will tell.
questions.explanation: versatile 多才多艺、用途多样，吻合时间会“飞、前进、疗伤、耗尽、揭示”；fertile 富有创造力或肥沃；fruitful 有成果；productive 多产。

questions.question: You shouldn’t ______ your father’s advice. Anyway he is much more experienced than you in this matter.
questions.explanation: defy 违抗、不遵从；denounce 公开谴责；deduce 推断；deliberate 深思、商议。题意是不要违背父亲的建议，不是公开谴责建议。

questions.question: After three hours of questioning the suspect broke down and ______.
questions.explanation: confess 可不带宾语表示“认罪”，也可 confess to doing；acknowledge 承认事实，常接宾语；recognize 认出、认可；concede 勉强承认或让步。嫌疑人崩溃后招供，选 confessed。

questions.question: This is a long ______—roughly 20 miles down a beautiful valley to the little village below.
questions.explanation: descent 表示下行路程；down、below 与向山谷下方行进的含义相呼应。

questions.question: These cameras do not take a ______ photograph but a series of images or scans indicating when each athlete crosses the finishing line.
questions.explanation: conventional 常规、传统方式的；classical 古典的、经典艺术体系的；conservative 保守的；formal 正式的。与扫描序列相对的是常规照片。

questions.question: Topics for composition should be ______ to the experiences and interests of students.
questions.explanation: be relevant to 表示与……相关；写作主题应与学生的经历、兴趣相关。

questions.question: The computer can be programmed to ______ a whole variety of tasks.
questions.explanation: tackle tasks 表示处理任务；solve 常接问题，realize 实现或意识到，assign 分配。

questions.question: Kelsey likes eating very much, but he isn’t very ______ about the food he eats.
questions.explanation: be particular about 对……挑剔讲究；peculiar 奇怪或特有，常见 peculiar to；special 特别的；specific 明确具体的。爱吃但不挑食，选 particular。

questions.question: What you say is not ______ with what you do.
questions.explanation: be consistent with 表示与……一致，句意为言行不一致。

questions.question: The Tibet Autonomous Region is 1.22 million sq.km. in area, with an average ______ of over 4,000m above sea level.
questions.explanation: altitude 指海拔高度，与 above sea level 呼应；latitude 纬度，aptitude 天资，gratitude 感激。

questions.question: Have you ever received ______ of what has happened to her?
questions.explanation: word 作“消息、音信”时通常不可数且不用冠词：receive/get word of/about…。word 作“单词”时才常是可数名词，不要机械加 the 或 s。

questions.question: The layout can be finished the day after tomorrow at a ______, but that would mean I must lose my weekend.
questions.explanation: at a push = 勉强、加把劲的话（英式），与牺牲周末才能赶完相符。impetus 推动力；drive 冲劲、驱动力，但不组成这里的习语。

questions.question: Tom was trying to sort through his ______ and bring them to some sort of order.
questions.explanation: belongings 随身或个人物品，复数对应 them；assets 资产；fortunes 财富或命运；property 财产，通常不可数。整理个人东西最贴近 belongings。
